china-1913:p0617_1.rationale: Census of foreign residents of the Shanghai International Settlement by nationality; the settlement is a foreign concession and the main breakdown is nationality.

china-1913:p0617_2.rationale: Roster of foreign envoys and ministers at Peking by seniority, with appointment years only incidental.

china-1913:p0617_3.rationale: Staff list of the British Legation at Peking with posts.

china-1913:p0618_1.rationale: Roster of British consular officers at Chinese ports, including the Shanghai Supreme Court judges and court staff, which supports extraterritorial jurisdiction. Dates of appointment are incidental.

china-1913:p0619_1.rationale: Continuation list of consular officers by port, with rank, name and appointment date.

china-1913:p0619_2.rationale: Roster of vice-consuls, assistants and student interpreters in the consular service, with appointment dates.

china-1913:p0620_1.rationale: Descriptive list of the districts of British consular marriage officers in China under the Foreign Marriage Act. It is textual and shows consular legal authority over British subjects.

china-1913:p0673_1.rationale: Annual net importation of foreign opium into China in piculs from the customs series.

china-1913:p0673_2.rationale: Decade averages of foreign opium imports in piculs.

china-1913:p0673_3.rationale: Average net weight per chest of each kind of opium, serving as a conversion of the chest unit to catties and pounds.
